date_note: Date is the article's publication day; the page gives no earlier day for the forum post.
title: Decathlon confirms malicious access to customer personal data at an external provider; hacker "4me1" claims a forum post, reportedly with 137 000 email addresses
summary: Decathlon told Ouest-France of "un accès malveillant à des données personnelles" at an external provider, per generation-nt, which says it plans to notify the CNIL. MCE TV, citing Capital.fr, says a hacker called "4me1" claims the attack and “plus de 137 000 adresses e-mail” (more than that number) are reportedly concerned, but that Decathlon had not officially confirmed it.
plain: Per generation-nt, Decathlon says someone gained malicious access to customer data at an external provider. MCE TV says a hacker claims it and “plus de 137 000 adresses e-mail” are reportedly concerned.
exec: Decathlon told Ouest-France of malicious access to customer data at an external provider, per generation-nt; “plus de 137 000 adresses e-mail” are reportedly concerned, per MCE TV.
action: MCE TV advises being wary of unexpected messages about an order or parcel, not clicking links in suspicious SMS or emails, and checking on the official Decathlon site or app.

sources.name: generation-nt: Decathlon victime d'une fuite de données

evidence.quote: plus de 137 000 adresses e-mail et des dizaines de milliers de coordonnées personnelles seraient concernées.
Decathlon nie przedstawił dotąd oficjalnego stanowiska w sprawie włamania
un accès malveillant à des données personnelles
care a identificat 163.646 de înregistrări de contact și 137.549 de adrese de e-mail distincte
À l’heure actuelle, Decathlon n’a pas confirmé officiellement cette cyberattaque.

validation.note: generation-nt relays Decathlon's statement to Ouest-France; the Ouest-France original was not read. MCE TV (relaying Capital.fr) and Money.pl report the forum claim. 01net, Les Numeriques, Cybernews, FMT and Astro Awani did not load.

review.note: stronger than source: MCE TV says Decathlon had not officially confirmed; summary now attributes confirmation to generation-nt, claim and figure to MCE TV; evidence added
